vo_open.text: For five years, a famous American dictionary had a word that doesn't exist.

vo.text: The word was dord. Meaning: density.
In 1931, an editor sent in a note: capital D or small d can mean density.
vo.cap: *1931:* a note. *"D or d"* can mean density.

vo.text: But headwords were typed with spaces between the letters. D, o, r, d.
vo.cap: But headwords were typed *with spaces.* D o r d...

vo.text: So D or d became dord. It was printed in 1934.
In 1939, an editor noticed it had no word origin.
vo.cap: *1939:* an editor noticed it had *no word origin.*

vo.text: By 1947 it was gone. The word that never was.
vo.cap: Gone by *1947.* The word that *never was.*
